statement: A planet with 0-3 Bindus in the sign it occupies is considered weak by Ashtakavarga's own-sign measure — its results in this chart tend to need more effort to realize, regardless of its dignity by sign lordship alone.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
